title: Cboe to Launch Continuous Bitcoin Futures on December 15
summary: Bitcoin MagazineCboe to Launch Continuous Bitcoin Futures on December 15Cboe Global Markets (Cboe: CBOE) announced that, pending regulatory approval, it will launch Bitcoin Continuous Futures (PBT) on its Cboe Futures Exchange (CFE) starting December 15.This postCboe to Launch Continuous Bitcoin Futures on December 15first appeared onBitcoin Magazineand is written byMicah Zimmerman.
